SPEC UNDER TEST: - Story: docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md - Requirements include: REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION, REQ-COMMENT-ASSOCIATION, REQ-ANNOTATION-PARSING, REQ-SIGNIFICANCE-CRITERIA, REQ-NESTED-HANDLING, REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE, REQ-PERFORMANCE-OPTIMIZATION.
IMPLEMENTATION: - Core rule implementation at src/rules/require-branch-annotation.ts: - File header: - `@story docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md` - `@req REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION` - `@req REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE` - Rule meta: - type: "problem" - docs.description: "Require @story and @req annotations on code branches" - fixable: "code" - messages.missingAnnotation: - JSDoc: `@story docs/stories/007.0-DEV-ERROR-REPORTING.story.md` - Message: `"Branch is missing required annotation: {{missing}}."` (clear, specific per missing item) - schema: validates `branchTypes` as an array of strings, uniqueItems, with additionalProperties: false. - create(context): - Calls validateBranchTypes(context) from ../utils/branch-annotation-helpers. - If validateBranchTypes returns a listener (invalid config), it returns that directly (config error mode). - Otherwise iterates over branchTypes and builds handlers for each AST node type. - For each branch node, handler: - Special-cases SwitchCase: `if (type === "SwitchCase" && (node as any).test == null) { return; }` to skip default case (significance criteria). - Calls reportMissingAnnotations(context, node, storyFixCountRef).
- Supporting utilities at src/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.ts: - DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES: - Values: ["IfStatement", "SwitchCase", "TryStatement", "CatchClause", "ForStatement", "ForOfStatement", "ForInStatement", "WhileStatement", "DoWhileStatement"]. - JSDoc: `@story docs/stories/004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.story.md` and `@req REQ-SIGNIFICANCE-CRITERIA` (defines which branches are significant by default). - validateBranchTypes(context): - JSDoc ties to `@req REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE`. - Reads `context.options[0] || {}` and checks `branchTypes`. - If branchTypes is array, filters invalid types not in DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES. - When invalidTypes.length > 0: - Returns `{ Program: ProgramHandler }` where ProgramHandler reports for each invalid type: - `message: "Value \"${t}\" should be equal to one of the allowed values: ${DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES.join(", ")}"`. - This matches story's invalid configuration behavior description. - On valid config or missing branchTypes, returns the configured branchTypes or a copy of DEFAULT_BRANCH_TYPES. - gatherBranchCommentText(sourceCode, node): - JSDoc: `@req REQ-COMMENT-ASSOCIATION`. - Special handling for SwitchCase: - Uses PRE_COMMENT_OFFSET (=2) to look up to two lines above the case. - While loop scans upwards as long as line matches `^\s*(//|/\*)`, collecting leading comment lines and joining them. - This supports association of comments immediately above case labels, including the fallback for blank lines (tested). - For other node types: - Uses `sourceCode.getCommentsBefore(node)` and maps comment nodes to `.value`, joining to a single string. - getBranchAnnotationInfo(sourceCode, node): - Internal helper used by reportMissingAnnotations. - Computes: - `missingStory` via `!/@story\b/.test(text)`. - `missingReq` via `!/@req\b/.test(text)`. - `indent` from the node's starting line. - `insertPos` via `sourceCode.getIndexFromLoc({ line: node.loc.start.line, column: 0 })`. - Implements REQ-ANNOTATION-PARSING behavior. - reportMissingStory(context, node, { indent, insertPos, storyFixCountRef }): - JSDoc references REQ-ANNOTATION-PARSING. - If `storyFixCountRef.count === 0`: - Reports with messageId "missingAnnotation" and data { missing: "@story" }. - Provides fixer inserting `${indent}// @story .story.md\n` before the branch. - Increments `storyFixCountRef.count` to limit placeholder insertion to first occurrence. - Else: - Reports missingAnnotation without fixer, preventing multiple placeholder @story insertions. - reportMissingReq(context, node, { indent, insertPos, missingStory }): - If `!missingStory`: - Reports missingAnnotation for "@req" and fixer inserting `${indent}// @req \n`. - Else: - Reports missingAnnotation without a fixer. - reportMissingAnnotations(context, node, storyFixCountRef): - Calls context.getSourceCode and getBranchAnnotationInfo. - Builds actions array with two entries for story and req. - Iterates actions, calling reportMissingStory / reportMissingReq when `item.missing` is true.
INTEGRATION INTO PLUGIN: - src/index.ts: - TRACEABILITY_RULE_SEVERITIES includes: - `"traceability/require-branch-annotation": "error",` - This map is used by createTraceabilityFlatConfig() to generate the flat config used in configs.recommended and configs.strict, ensuring the rule participates in the core presets.

`[REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION] valid switch-case with inline annotation`. - `[REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION] valid default case without annotations` (demonstrates default is treated as non-significant branch or acceptable without annotation, matching significance criteria in helpers). - `[REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE] custom branchTypes ignores unlisted branch types` with branchTypes ["IfStatement"] so switch is unchecked. - `[REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE] custom branchTypes only enforce listed types` verifying only IfStatement is enforced when configured. - Invalid tests (Missing Annotations, Error Messages, Fix Behavior, Config Error Handling): - `[REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION] missing annotations on if-statement`: - Input: `if (condition) {}`. - Output: Adds `// @story .story.md` above the if. - Expect two errors: one for '@story', one for '@req', with messageId "missingAnnotation" and data { missing: "@story" } and { missing: "@req" }. - `[REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION] missing @req on for loop when only story present`: - Input: `// @story ...\nfor(...) {}`. - Output: adds `// @req `. - Errors: missingAnnotation for '@req' only. - `[REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION] missing @story on while loop when only req present`. - `[REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION] missing annotations on switch-case` (ensures SwitchCase handling works). - `[REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION] missing annotations on do-while loop`. - `[REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION] missing annotations on for-of loop`. - `[REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION] missing annotations on for-in loop`. - `[REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION] missing annotations on try-catch blocks`: - Expects errors for both try and catch nodes, demonstrating nested handling and multi-branch coverage. - `[REQ-BRANCH-DETECTION] missing annotations on switch-case with blank line`: - Verifies that even when there is a blank line between the opening brace and `case`, annotations are inserted above the case and detected correctly. - `[REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE] missing annotations on configured branch type ForStatement` with branchTypes ["ForStatement"]. - `[REQ-CONFIGURABLE-SCOPE] invalid branchTypes option should error schema`: - Options: [{ branchTypes: ["UnknownType"] }]. - Expects an error with a message matching `/should be equal to one of the allowed values/`, matching validateBranchTypes' behavior.
- Helper tests at tests/utils/branch-annotation-helpers.test.ts: - `should return default branch types when no options provided`. - `should return custom branch types when valid options provided`. - `should return listener when invalid branch types provided and report errors`. - These confirm configurable scope and invalid-config error handling behavior.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA CHECK: - Core Functionality (detect missing annotations on significant branches): - Implemented via require-branch-annotation rule + helpers; tested across if, switch (including cases with blank lines), try/catch, loops (for, for-of, for-in, while, do-while). - Quality Standards (ESLint best practices, performance): - Rule uses standard RuleModule structure, meta.schema for options validation, and focused helpers to minimize per-node work. - Only inspects a small number of lines or comments around each branch (efficient for large files). - Integration (works with nested structures and patterns): - Listeners are registered for AST node types; ESLint traversal naturally handles nested branches. - Tests include try/catch and multiple case forms, demonstrating correct behavior in nested contexts. - User Experience (clear error messages): - Single, clear message template: `Branch is missing required annotation: {{missing}}.` - Tests assert correct missing values ("@story" vs "@req"). - Error Handling (nested branches, complex conditionals, config errors): - Tests for try/catch, switch with blank lines, and invalid branchTypes confirm robust handling. - Documentation (examples and configuration): - docs/rules/require-branch-annotation.md contains explanation, config options, and examples tied to this story.
Based on this evidence, the implemented behavior matches all specified requirements and acceptance criteria for Story 004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS.
traceability.notes: Story 004.0-DEV-BRANCH-ANNOTATIONS is fully implemented. There is a dedicated ESLint rule (require-branch-annotation) that enforces @story and @req on significant branch types (if, switch cases, try/catch, loops), with configurable scope via the branchTypes option and robust invalid-configuration handling. Comment association, annotation parsing, and branch significance criteria are implemented in dedicated helper utilities. Comprehensive Jest tests validate valid and invalid scenarios across all branch types, nested/complex structures, and configuration error paths. The rule is integrated into the plugin’s recommended/strict configurations, and a dedicated documentation page provides usage, configuration, and examples. All acceptance criteria from the story are satisfied and verified by passing tests.
